_comment: Topoli user-facing strings — English (canonical). Every key exists in fr/de/it too. Values are written per language, never machine-translated. Slots in {braces} are filled by code; format numbers/dates with topoli.core.i18n.format first.

A.label: Official fact
A.line: Official fact — taken as published by the responsible authority.

B.label: Calculation
B.line: Calculation — computed deterministically from official data; the formula is shown.

C.label: Estimate
C.line: Estimate — a rough figure from simplifying assumptions; verify before relying on it.

D.label: Needs a professional
D.line: Needs a professional — cannot be determined from public data; ask the office named.

coverage.degraded: Checked with an older copy — the source did not answer today
coverage.not_available: Not available for this canton yet
coverage.not_contributed: Not yet contributed for this municipality
coverage.help_add: Not available for this canton yet — help add it → {url}
coverage.notice: What was checked: {ok} sources. Not available here: {missing}.

caveat.downgraded_missing_source: This could not be tied to an official source with a retrieval time, so it is shown as needing a professional check.
caveat.downgraded_missing_span: No article of the regulation could be quoted for {rule}, so this is shown as needing a professional check.
caveat.conflicting_sources: Two official sources disagree here ({source_a} vs. {source_b}); both are listed and a professional should settle it.
caveat.stale_as_of: As of {date} — the source could not be reached today, so an earlier copy was used.

trust.not_replace: This does not replace an architect, the planning office, a notary, the land register, a surveyor, an engineer or an environmental consultant.
trust.no_valuation: It never produces valuations, cost estimates or approval likelihoods.
trust.local: It runs on your machine and talks only to official public sources.

install.step2: Add the skill: paste the repository URL or run the one-line install command shown.

progress.not_available: ⚠ {what} not available for {where} — help add it
progress.degraded: ⚠ {what}: source unavailable today, using a copy from {date}

none.title: Flood risk: none identified in the federal flood maps.
none.consequence: No flood-related constraint on building from the federal maps.
none.caveat: Federal Aquaprotect maps only; the cantonal hazard map may differ and is the one that counts for permits.

low.title: Flood risk: low — only a very rare flood (1 in 500 years) would reach {pct} of the plot.
low.consequence: Usually no constraint, but insurers and the canton may ask for precautions.
low.caveat: Federal Aquaprotect map; check the cantonal hazard map before planning.

medium.title: Flood risk: yes — a 1-in-100-year flood could reach {pct} of the plot.
medium.consequence: Basements, ground floors and technical rooms may need flood protection; the canton can impose conditions.
medium.caveat: Federal Aquaprotect map; the cantonal hazard map and its danger levels are decisive.

none.title: Heavy-rain runoff: no exposure marked for this plot.
none.consequence: No special measures indicated for surface water from heavy rain.
none.caveat: Federal surface-runoff map, modelled; local drainage can still cause problems.

low.title: Heavy-rain runoff: {pct} of the plot can be reached by surface water during heavy rain.
low.consequence: Entrances, light wells and garage ramps may need protection against water from the street or slope.
low.caveat: Federal surface-runoff map, modelled from terrain; not a legal hazard zone.

none.title: Rockfall, avalanche and landslide: no process area marked here.
none.consequence: No mountain-hazard constraint indicated by the federal models.
none.caveat: Federal SilvaProtect-CH model; the cantonal hazard map is decisive.

low.title: Rockfall, avalanche or landslide: a federal model marks {pct} of the plot as a possible process area.
low.consequence: The canton may require a hazard assessment or protective measures before building.
low.caveat: Federal SilvaProtect-CH model (not a legal hazard zone); the cantonal hazard map is decisive.

low.title: Road noise: low (about {day} dB by day, {night} dB at night).
low.consequence: Road noise should not limit how homes can be laid out.
low.caveat: Federal noise model at one point of the plot; the legal limit depends on the zone's noise sensitivity level.

medium.title: Road noise: moderate (about {day} dB by day, {night} dB at night).
medium.consequence: Bedrooms and living rooms may have to face away from the road or use sound-insulating windows.
medium.caveat: Federal noise model at one point of the plot; the legal limit depends on the zone's noise sensitivity level.

high.title: Road noise: high (about {day} dB by day, {night} dB at night).
high.consequence: New homes usually need a noise concept: rooms facing away from the road, special windows or ventilation.
high.caveat: Federal noise model at one point of the plot; the legal limit depends on the zone's noise sensitivity level.

low.title: Railway noise: low (about {day} dB by day, {night} dB at night).
low.consequence: Railway noise should not limit how homes can be laid out.
low.caveat: Federal railway noise model at one point of the plot.

medium.title: Railway noise: moderate (about {day} dB by day, {night} dB at night).
medium.consequence: Bedrooms may have to face away from the tracks or use sound-insulating windows.
medium.caveat: Federal railway noise model at one point of the plot.

high.title: Railway noise: high (about {day} dB by day, {night} dB at night).
high.consequence: New homes usually need a noise concept: rooms facing away from the tracks, special windows or ventilation.
high.caveat: Federal railway noise model at one point of the plot.

none.title: Polluted sites: no entry in the federal registers for this plot.
none.consequence: No federal record of contamination from railways, airfields or the military.
none.caveat: Most polluted sites are in the cantonal register, which is shown under official restrictions where the canton publishes it.

hit.title: Polluted site: this plot is in a federal register ({name}, {status}).
hit.consequence: Building or digging here may require investigation or remediation at your cost.
hit.caveat: As published by the federal authority; ask the cantonal environment office for the file.

theme.title: Official restriction: {theme} — {legend} ({pct} of the plot).
theme.consequence: Set by {office}; status: {status}. It binds what you may build here.
theme.caveat: Taken from the official cadastre of public-law restrictions; read the linked legal provisions before deciding.

none.title: Official restrictions: the cadastre lists none for this plot ({area} m²).
none.caveat: Only themes published in the cadastre are covered; not all restrictions are in it yet.

none.title: Solar: no roof data available for this plot.
none.consequence: Nothing can be said about solar potential from federal data.
none.caveat: The federal roof dataset covers most but not all buildings.

poor.title: Solar: the roofs here are poorly suited for solar panels.
poor.consequence: Panels would produce little; a facade or shared installation may be the better option.
poor.caveat: Federal roof model (Sonnendach); shading by trees or new buildings is not fully captured.

medium.title: Solar: the best roof is moderately suited for solar panels ({area} m² usable, about {yield_mwh} MWh a year).
medium.consequence: Panels are possible; the yield is average for Switzerland.
medium.caveat: Federal roof model (Sonnendach); shading and roof condition are not fully captured.

good.title: Solar: the roofs are well suited for solar panels ({area} m² usable, about {yield_mwh} MWh a year).
good.consequence: A solar installation is likely worthwhile; many cantons subsidise it.
good.caveat: Federal roof model (Sonnendach); shading and roof condition are not fully captured.

very_good.title: Solar: the roofs are very well suited for solar panels ({area} m² usable, about {yield_mwh} MWh a year).
very_good.consequence: A solar installation is likely worthwhile; many cantons subsidise it.
very_good.caveat: Federal roof model (Sonnendach); shading and roof condition are not fully captured.

excellent.title: Solar: the roofs are excellently suited for solar panels ({area} m² usable, about {yield_mwh} MWh a year).
excellent.consequence: A solar installation is likely worthwhile; many cantons subsidise it.
excellent.caveat: Federal roof model (Sonnendach); shading and roof condition are not fully captured.

kgs.title: Heritage: {name} is a listed cultural property of national or regional importance (category {category}).
kgs.consequence: Demolition or major changes need the heritage authority's approval.
kgs.caveat: Federal inventory (KGS); cantonal and municipal inventories may list more.

unesco.title: Heritage: this plot lies in the UNESCO World Heritage site {name}.
unesco.consequence: Changes to buildings and the townscape are strictly controlled.
unesco.caveat: Federal perimeter; the cantonal and municipal rules apply.

none.title: Heritage: no federal listing found for this plot.
none.consequence: No constraint from the federal heritage inventories.
none.caveat: The federal townscape inventory and cantonal/municipal inventories are not queryable here yet; check them locally.

flat.title: Terrain: flat — the plot rises about {slope_pct}% ({min}–{max} m above sea level).
flat.consequence: No extra cost or constraint from the slope.
flat.caveat: Estimated from the national elevation model along the plot's diagonals.

sloped.title: Terrain: sloped — the plot rises about {slope_pct}% ({min}–{max} m above sea level).
sloped.consequence: Access, foundations and drainage need more planning; retaining walls may be needed.
sloped.caveat: Estimated from the national elevation model along the plot's diagonals.

steep.title: Terrain: steep — the plot rises about {slope_pct}% ({min}–{max} m above sea level).
steep.consequence: Building is more expensive here; a geotechnical assessment is usually required.
steep.caveat: Estimated from the national elevation model along the plot's diagonals.

source.title: {what}: not available for {where} yet.
source.consequence: This check could not be made ({reason}). Help add it →
source.caveat: No data means no statement, not 'no risk'.
